diagnosis.detail: The init-script task referenced the Gradle script object at execution time via gradle.rootProject/gradle.gradleVersion, which Gradle 9.6.1 configuration cache rejects before any topology output or worker test.

successor_rule: Preserve this original. Capture project directory and Gradle version as configuration-time scalar values and use only those values inside doLast; re-pin the changed daemon probe/workflow. Do not rerun unchanged.
